title: CareerOps JD Analysis
description: Structured analysis of a job description produced by jd-analyzer subagent

keywords_verbatim.description: Exact strings lifted from JD text -- used in Gate 3 keyword check

target_facts.description: v1: Fact IDs the jd-analyzer recommends featuring. Superseded by ranked_facts[] in v2 but kept for backward compatibility.

ranked_facts.description: v2: All known facts scored by relevance to this JD. Higher score = more relevant. Advisory only -- bullet-composer reads all facts regardless. Sorted descending by score.

fact_id.description: Fact ID -- references a fact embedded in career/experiences/X-*.yaml

score.description: Relevance score: 1.0 = 3+ required keyword matches with strong metric; 0.8-0.99 = 2+ required; 0.6-0.79 = 1 required or 2+ preferred; <0.6 = low relevance

matched_keywords.description: Verbatim JD keywords that matched this fact
